set.tovw: Lead grade D (treasure thread): amount rests on the victim's claim; robber said $80; bail misread as bonds

tw-wi-hartford-bauer-1898.st: The Kewaskum Statesman (4 Jun 1898) gives the assailant's statement that the victim had only $80 on him; the $1,028 (elsewhere $1,125) is the victim's own claim, and the '$5,000 bonds' in one report was the bail, not money carried. It says the assailant 'went into the woods' at the stop.

set.tovw: Lead grade F (treasure thread): $722 dug up by the county attorney and sheriff in May 1939
